wang-2024.title: Precise mode control of laser-written waveguides for broadband, low-dispersion 3D integrated optics
wang-2024.access_notes: Main text, methods and publisher supplementary DOCX inspected. Text S7 defines circularity as minor/major axes, Fig. S9 summarizes MFD, and Figs. S8 and S13–S15 provide mode images. No standalone source-data or data-availability statement was found in the publisher's article. The DOCX contains an embedded Origin graph at Fig. S9. No calibrated camera grids or phase data were identified in the material reviewed.
